problem: Onboarding a new vendor at Northlight Studios takes six weeks on average, with intake forms bouncing between Procurement, Legal, and Finance because no single team owns the handoff. Vendors wait, launches slip, and staff re-enter the same information three times.

risks.mitigation: Pre-agreed review SLA with a named backup reviewer
risks.risk: Legal review becomes a bottleneck under the new SLA

risks.mitigation: Procurement walks the first two pilot vendors through the form live
risks.risk: Pilot vendors are reluctant to use the new intake form

scope_in: Redesign the vendor intake form and the handoff between Procurement, Legal, and Finance
Single owner for each onboarding step, with a published SLA
Pilot the redesigned flow with five new vendors

stakeholders.name: Marcus Chen
stakeholders.responsibility: Owns the intake form and vendor contact

stakeholders.name: Sofia Reyes
stakeholders.responsibility: Owns compliance checks and review SLA

success_criteria.measure: From 6 weeks to 3 weeks or less

success_criteria: Pilot vendors onboarded under the new flow with no escalations past tier 1
